query:
SELECT
                r.name AS "repository!: String",
                w.slug AS "slug!: String",
                w.title AS "title!: String",
                w.body AS "body!: String",
                w.created_at AS "created_at!: String",
                w.updated_at AS "updated_at!: String"
            FROM
                wiki_pages w
            JOIN
                repositories r ON r.id = w.repository_id
            ORDER BY
                r.name, w.slug
